data.name: Azaam
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'azana' which means 'to amaze'. Azaam is a name of great power, might, and respect. It is a name of honor and nobility, reminding us of the greatness of Allah.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the greatness and power of Allah.

in_arabic.name: عظیم
in_arabic.long_meaning: عظیم نام کا مطلب ہے بہت بڑا، عالی شان، یا کسی چیز کی بڑائی کرنا۔ یہ نام عظیم کے معنی میں جڑا ہوا ہے جو عظیمیت اور شان و شوکت کی علامت ہے۔ اسلامی روایت میں، یہ نام اچھے اخلاق اور عظیم شان کے حامل فرد کے لئے منتخب کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_urdu.name: اعظیم
in_urdu.meaning: بہت بڑا، عظیم الشان، عالی شان
in_urdu.long_meaning: اعظیم نام کا مطلب ہے بہت بڑا یا عالی شان۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کے 'عظیم' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے بڑا یا شاندار۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم روایت میں، یہ نام عظیمیت، شان و شوکت، اور اچھے اخلاق کے حامل فرد کے لئے منتخب کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अज़ीम
in_hindi.long_meaning: अज़ीम नाम का अर्थ है बहुत बड़ा या महान। यह नाम अरबी भाषा के 'अज़ीम' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है बड़ा या शानदार। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम महानता, शानदारता, और अच्छे चरित्र के साथ जुड़ा हुआ है।

in_pashto.name: عظیم
in_pashto.long_meaning: عظیم نوم د لوی معنی لري، هغه چې ډیر لوی یا مهم دی. دا نوم د عربی ژبې له 'عظیم' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې لوی یا مهم دی. د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ارزښتونو له مخې، دا نوم د لويه او ویاړ وړ ځانګړتیاوو لرونکی کس لپاره کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Azaam
in_english.long_meaning: The name Azaam originates from the Arabic root 'a-z-m,' which means great, magnificent, or extremely large. Referenced in various Islamic texts, the term 'azam' signifies grandeur, majesty, and immense importance. Historically, the name Azaam has been used to denote individuals with remarkable qualities, high moral standards, and distinguished characteristics. The name symbolizes greatness, dignity, and reverence in the Islamic tradition.

data.cultural_impact: The name Azaam signifies strength, power, and respect in the Arab and wider Islamic world. Individuals given the name Azaam are often viewed as authoritative figures, commanding awe and admiration from those around them. The name evokes a sense of astonishment, suggesting that the bearer is someone extraordinary and worthy of notice.
data.spiritual_significance: On a more spiritual level, the name Azaam serves as a reminder of the greatness of Allah and the vastness of His vast Universe. By bearing this name, the individual is constantly reminded of their role as a servant of Allah, inspired to live a life of humility and submission to the will of the Almighty. The name Azaam also carries the weight of responsibility, urging the bearer to strive for excellence in all aspects of life as a reflection of the tremendous power and might of Allah.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidayah wa Al-Nihayah, Volume 11, page 119. The name Azaam carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Azaam ibn Marwan was a prominent companion of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). He embraced Islam in the early days and took part in several battles, including the Battle of Uhud (625 AD) and the Battle of Hunayn (630 AD). Azaam was known for his generosity and bravery.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Isabah fi Tamyiz Al-Sahabah by Ibn Hajar Al-Asqalani, Volume 2, page 160. The name Azaam carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Azaam ibn Marwan was among the first converts to Islam in Makkah. He was a wealthy young man who spent his wealth in the cause of Islam and aided the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) in many ways, including providing food and shelter to the migrants (Muhajirun) who came to Madinah.
